narrative.intro: This ranking covers fastest-growing federal contract markets in FY2026 to date, measured as year-over-year changes in contract obligations for the same fiscal period. Total federal contract obligations for this fiscal-year-to-date period are $236B. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction grew 162.5%. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction grew 142.8%. Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services grew 110.4%. Automobile Manufacturing grew 95.2%. Research and Development in Biotechnology (except Nanobiotechnology) grew 67.0%. Software Publishers grew 45.7%. All Other Travel Arrangement and Reservation Services grew 43.7%. Other Technical and Trade Schools grew 42.9%. Telecommunications Resellers grew 36.4%. Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction grew 27.9%. All figures report contract obligations and current-year totals are partial because they reflect fiscal year to date.

sections.heading: Which industries show the largest year-over-year gains?
sections.body: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction grew 162.5%. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction grew 142.8%. Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services grew 110.4%. Automobile Manufacturing grew 95.2%. These four industries lead the ranking by percentage growth for FY2026 to date.

sections.heading: What does FY2026 to date mean in this ranking?
sections.body: FY2026 to date means the figures cover the current fiscal year up to the reporting date and are partial totals. All values are year-over-year changes in contract obligations for the same period, so comparisons match the same time window across years.

faq.q: What are the fastest-growing federal contract markets?
faq.a: The fastest-growing federal contract markets are the ten industries listed in the ranking: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction (162.5%), Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction (142.8%), Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services (110.4%), Automobile Manufacturing (95.2%), Research and Development in Biotechnology (except Nanobiotechnology) (67.0%), Software Publishers (45.7%), All Other Travel Arrangement and Reservation Services (43.7%), Other Technical and Trade Schools (42.9%), Telecommunications Resellers (36.4%), and Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction (27.9%).

faq.q: How is market growth measured here?
faq.a: Growth is measured as year-over-year change in contract obligations for the same fiscal period, comparing FY2026 to date with the same period in the prior year. The ranking notes that all figures are contract obligations and that current-year totals are partial because they represent fiscal year to date.
